text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... Aaand done. Hm, I'mgetting through these exercises muchfaster than before.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We've been training together for<n>some time now,
and Wonder Acute's<n>endurance has indeed
improved<n>markedly.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And I know who I have to thank for<n>that. All I've
done is train just like<n>you tell me to, but I can
already feel<n>the difference.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Plus, you're always changing up the<n>routine, so
I'm learning so many new<n>things. If we keep this
up, my<n>2,000-meter dirt race should be no<n>problem.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's kind enough to hand me<n>compliments here
and there, but I'm<n>frankly more impressed with her
than<n>she is with me.
choice_data_list: Thank your own tenacity—it's your secret weapon.
Thank your own tenacity—it's your secret weapon.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Every time I increased her training<n>load, she didn't
so much as utter a<n>word of complaint. Day in and
day out<n>she put in the work, and it shows.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
If she keeps this up, she'll be able to<n>build a solid
track record once she<n>debuts. Picturing that future
renews<n>my resolve to train her as best I can.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If you didn't tell me I had my very<n>own secret
weapon, I never<n>would've known. Just another
thing I<n>owe you for.
choice_data_list: Let's put it to even better use!
Let's put it to even better use!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, sounds to me like you're<n>cooking up
another new training plan.<n>I'll be waiting! There's
nothing you<n>can give me that I can't do.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I spend the rest of the morning on my<n>new training
plan, then go looking for<n>Wonder Acute. She's not
in her<n>classroom, so I step outside and<n>find...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're Acute's trainer, aren't<n>you? If you're
looking for her, she's<n>right over here.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm motioned over to Wonder Acute<n>and her two
friends, Hokko Tarumae<n>and Copano Rickey,
standing in a<n>circle.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Acute, you really went and<n>signed on with a
trainer?! If you've<n>found the yin to your yang, count
yourself very lucky and happy! ☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, I'm afraid I haven't signed<n>anything just
yet. I'm just borrowing<n>a helping hand for the
Tracen Meet.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Really? That's too bad. I mean, even<n>I've heard the
rumors—a promising<n>new trainer who graduated
trainer<n>school with top honors in seven<n>subjects?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Is that right? I didn't know you were<n>such a
distinguished trainer.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're always so humble. You<n>should give
yourself more credit, you<n>know. Thanks to your
help, I think I'll<n>be able to put up a good fight at the
Tracen Meet.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
A good fight... I don't know. I mean,<n>considering
who you're up against...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wait, so you haven't heard? Acute's<n>2,000-meter
dirt race is also going to<n>have...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Woohoohooo! Falco, taking flight.<n>Here I gooo! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Dwah!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at her! This is incredible!<n>It's almost like
she's drawing qi<n>straight from the dragon veins
into<n>her legs!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Explosive acceleration, speed that<n>picks up even
more at the end...<n>She's just different—no one can
outshine Falco on the dirt.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: The field hasn't been announced yet,but I've heard she'll be running.Besting Falco on dirt would be nearlyimpossible for anyone right now.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Also, fire conquers metal. Our Acute<n>here may have
a resolve of steel, but<n>Falco and her fiery running
will be a<n>menace according to feng shui!
choice_data_list: So that's what we're up against, huh.
So that's what we're up against, huh.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I can't get Smart Falcon's running<n>out of my mind.
Don't get me wrong,<n>Wonder Acute has shown
great<n>improvement, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Phew. I'm not done yet!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, remind me what I'm doing<n>next? ...Oh?
Trainer, dear?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
This is no time to be spacing out. I<n>can't let all her
hard work go to<n>waste. There has to be more I can
do,<n>but my mind is drawing blanks.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I mean, her opponent is not only<n>post-debut, she's
one of the top<n>active runners. The gap is
undeniable.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Come on, Trainer, no need to be<n>shy, now.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I know full well I won't stand a<n>chance at this rate.
So if I'm to put up<n>a fight against Falco, you'll have
to<n>make me a tougher routine.
choice_data_list: But... I don't want to overwork you.
But... I don't want to overwork you.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her current load is already the result<n>of me
gradually upping the intensity<n>as she grew. Any
more than this<n>would be unrealistic.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I know that, but I wonder if there isn't<n>something
else I could be doing.<n>Like... honing my body for the
race,<n>for example.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Let me tell you about the time I ran for<n>Tracen's
entrance exams. The<n>nerves got to me, and I
showed up on<n>the day weighing a good bit less
than<n>usual.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But somehow I felt better than ever, if<n>you can
believe it. My legs felt so<n>free, like they might carry
me off to<n>the ends of the earth.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If I could hone my body like that<n>again, I'd have a
puncher's chance—I<n>just know it.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's true that cutting weight to<n>maximize
performance is something<n>you see a lot. All else
equal, the<n>lighter you are, the faster you run.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But that aside, I'm impressed at her<n>tenacity.
Rather than let a superior<n>opponent intimidate her,
she's<n>focused on improving her chances<n>any way
she can.
choice_data_list: Is Smart Falcon someone you really want to beat?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, I wouldn't say that. Who I'm up<n>against
doesn't matter to me. It's<n>more that...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A win in this race would mean an<n>awful lot to
someone I know. So no<n>matter what, I need to earn
this win<n>for that someone.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And that, Trainer, is why I need you to<n>be tougher
on me. I trust you, so you<n>go on and trust me to
keep up.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I don't know who this someone is,<n>but whatever
her reasons may be, if<n>she wants to win, then it's
my job as<n>a trainer to make it happen.
choice_data_list: All right. Let's rethink your training plan!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With that, I set my mind to preparing a
weight-cutting routine for Wonder<n>Acute.
